question: India mein unlimited aur limited legal tender mein kya farq hai?
essence: Valid banknotes ki amount limit nahi; coins ke liye legally prescribed acceptance limits hain.
answer: Unlimited legal tender kisi bhi amount ke liye accept kiya jana chahiye, provided note genuine aur valid ho. Book ₹10, ₹20, ₹50, ₹100, ₹200 aur ₹500 banknotes list karti hai aur RBI Act, 1934 ka reference deti hai. Limited legal tender mein prescribed limit tak acceptance compulsory hai; uske beyond voluntary. Coins ke liye book Coinage Act, 2011 ka reference deti hai. [p005]
deep_dive: ₹1, ₹2, ₹5, ₹10 aur ₹20 coins ki tender limit ₹1,000 hai; 50 paise coins ki ₹10. Yeh payment/tender ki amount limits hain, coin rakhne ki limits nahi. Limit ke beyond voluntary acceptance aur demonetized coin ka no-legal-tender status ek baat nahi: 50 paise se neeche ke coins ab legal tender nahi hain. [p005]
